description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Column' which extends 'DynamicComponent'. It includes styling, template, and input properties related to layout configuration such as alignment and distribution for a column element.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: An Angular component that represents a layout column with configurable alignment and distribution, extending DynamicComponent and rendered via a template with styling for flexbox layout.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property for the column's alignment, defaulting to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property for the column's distribution, defaulting to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: Computed property that generates CSS classes based on theme, alignment, and distribution.
